## Summary

Describe the problem, the resulting behavior, and any compatibility changes.
Link related issues when applicable.

## Validation

List the commands run and their results. Identify skipped or unavailable checks.
For documentation-only changes, note which examples or links were checked.

## Performance evidence

For performance changes, include the GPU and software versions, frozen Trace input
and baseline identity, tested shapes, absolute baseline/candidate latencies,
timing method, coverage, and regressions. Link reproducible raw results.
Otherwise, mark this section as not applicable.

## Checklist

- [ ] Relevant tests, lint, and formatting checks pass.
- [ ] Documentation and user-facing text are in English and reflect the implementation.
- [ ] License notices and attribution are preserved for any imported code.
- [ ] Correctness and performance claims match the attached evidence.
